description: Catalog of all 24 themes with package names, export names and light or dark mode.

label: Basic
description: Basic Dark and Basic Light, neutral themes with a plain palette.
excerpt: A neutral pair for apps that want CodeMirror to blend in rather than stand out.

label: GitHub
description: GitHub Dark and GitHub Light, themes inspired by the GitHub code view.
excerpt: Colors inspired by the GitHub code view, in both modes.

label: Gruvbox
description: Gruvbox Dark and Gruvbox Light, warm retro themes based on the Gruvbox palette.
excerpt: Warm, retro colors based on the Gruvbox palette.

label: Material
description: Material Dark and Material Light, themes based on the Material palette.
excerpt: A light and a dark variant based on the Material palette.

label: Solarized
description: Solarized Dark and Solarized Light, themes based on the Solarized palette.
excerpt: The classic Solarized palette in both modes.

description: Ten single-variant dark themes, from Abcdef to Volcano.

description: Tokyo Night Day and Tokyo Night Storm, themes based on the Tokyo Night palette.
excerpt: Tokyo Night in a light (Day) and a dark (Storm) variant.

description: VS Code Dark and VS Code Light, themes inspired by the Visual Studio Code defaults.
